scenarios.name: Quickstart: agent echoes the user
scenarios.description: Sanity-check scenario for the in-process transport. The agent echoes the user's message verbatim inside its reply.

turns.message: book me a table for tonight

turns.golden_response: [model=echo-1] Hello! I heard: 'book me a table for tonight'. (You are a friendly concierge. Greet the user.)

scenarios.expected_outcome: Agent greets the user and echoes the request verbatim.
